description.en: A forward element lost part of its maintenance reserve. Recover a small, defined set of ordinary field-service supplies and deliver them as one operational package. This is a one-off logistics problem, not an open procurement queue.
description.ru: Передовая группа потеряла часть ремонтного резерва. Собери небольшой заранее определённый комплект обычных полевых расходников и передай его как единый оперативный пакет. Это разовая задача снабжения, а не бесконечная очередь поручений.

started.en: Bring only what the package calls for. I need a usable reserve, not a warehouse inventory.
started.ru: Принеси только то, что входит в комплект. Мне нужен рабочий резерв, а не складской инвентарь.

success.en: That closes the shortage. The element can maintain itself again; there is no reason to turn this into another shopping list.
success.ru: Дефицит закрыт. Группа снова может обслуживать себя сама; превращать это в очередной список покупок незачем.

operation.objectiveIntent: One contextual maintenance-reserve handover using a fixed six-unit package of ordinary repair/maintenance consumables. Exact TPL selection, overlap and Economy Admiral acquisition-burden review are resolved; the operation remains plan-only behind the frozen post-0.1.0 materialization boundary.

economyReview.authority: Pinned SPT handbook values already recorded in PR #297 source-of-truth checkpoint for exact payload TPLs.
economyReview.decision: Keep the six-unit, three-TPL maintenance identity but remove one Sewing kit and replace it with one Duct tape. The expensive Sewing kit remains present for soft-gear maintenance identity without dominating a level-15 routine acquisition sink. Do not inflate the RUB reward to compensate for the old payload; that would reward-list escalation instead of fixing the burden source.

handoverCompatibility.legacyRisk: The maintained SPT 4.1 QuestManiac port documents legacy handover conditions with maxDurability=0, which is not the documented full usable durability range for repairable weapons, helmets and armor; its converter normalizes those conditions to the vanilla-style 100 ceiling.
handoverCompatibility.admiralDecision: Exact SPT handover durability semantics are statically proven: repairable payloads are mechanically representable with minDurability=0 and maxDurability=100. The selected Field-Expedient Supply payload intentionally uses only non-repairable ordinary service consumables, so durability bounds are not needed for the selected items.

sourceReference.finding: 3423 legacy HandoverItem/FindItem/LeaveItemAtLocation durability ceilings normalized from 0 to 100

overlapCompatibility.scopeBoundary: Frozen Admiral, Scorpion, Artem and pinned vanilla-derived demand sub-gates are resolved. Artem contains a Sewing kit competing sink; vanilla contains WD-40 quest demand and hideout demand for all three payload TPLs. None is a duplicate maintenance-reserve operation or supply faucet. Economy review therefore reduces Sewing-kit quantity rather than replacing the maintenance payload identity.
